use_en: Three complete salvos in one clip; cut one out with --range and feed the victory fireworks pool.
use_zh: 一条片子里三发完整的礼花；用 --range 切出一发，喂给胜利界面的烟花池。
prompt_en: A fireworks display against pure black. A single thin ember streaks up from the bottom of the frame, slows at the top of its arc and bursts into a wide, perfectly round sphere of hundreds of separate sparks flying outward, each spark a small sharp point of white-hot light dragging one thin bright trail behind it. The sphere expands fast, the sparks slow and arc over, their trails thin out and break into flickering fragments that twinkle and go out one by one until the frame is completely black again. Then a second burst does the same slightly left and higher, and a third slightly right and lower — each one complete and separate: rise, burst, fall, die out to black before the next ember goes up. The sparks are white-hot at the core and fall through warm gold, and the whole burst is a sphere of distinct points and trails rather than a soft glowing cloud. The background is pure flat black, completely empty and perfectly still: no smoke, no haze, no mist, no fog, no atmospheric glow, no ground, no horizon, no city, no buildings, no trees, no water, no reflections, no crowd, no silhouettes, no stars, no clouds, no moon. Nothing in the frame is lit except the firework itself. Locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax, no cuts, no scene change. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear. Every burst stays fully inside the frame and never touches the edges. Clean high-contrast game VFX plate, bright light on black, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no letterboxing.
prompt_zh: 纯黑背景下的烟花。一颗细小的火星从画面下方拖着尾迹升起，在弧顶减速，然后炸开成一个巨大而浑圆的球体，数百颗彼此分离的火星向外飞散，每一颗都是一个细小锐利的白热光点，身后拖着一条细亮的尾迹。球体迅速扩张，火星减速并划弧下坠，尾迹变细、碎成闪烁的碎屑，一颗接一颗地眨着熄灭，直到画面重新变成全黑。随后第二发在稍偏左、稍偏高处重复同样的过程，第三发在稍偏右、稍偏低处再来一次——每一发都完整而独立：升空、绽放、坠落、彻底熄灭到全黑，下一颗火星才升起。火星核心是白热的，下坠时转为暖金色；整个绽放是由清晰分明的光点和尾迹构成的球体，而不是柔软的发光云团。背景是纯正的全黑，完全空旷、绝对静止：没有烟雾、没有雾气、没有薄雾、没有霭、没有大气辉光，没有地面、没有地平线、没有城市、没有建筑、没有树木、没有水面、没有倒影，没有人群、没有剪影，没有星星、没有云、没有月亮。画面中除了烟花本身，没有任何被照亮的东西。固定机位，镜头完全锁定，无镜头运动、无变焦、无推近、无横摇、无俯仰、无环绕、无抖动、无视差，无剪辑、无场景切换。无镜头光晕，无覆盖整个画面的泛光，无暗角，无景深虚化，无胶片颗粒，无运动模糊拖影。每一次绽放都完整地留在画面内，绝不触碰画面边缘。干净的高对比游戏特效素材，黑底亮光，无文字、无数字、无水印、无标志、无黑边。

name_en: Willow — the long hold under the victory banner
name_zh: 垂柳 — 胜利横幅下的长时停留
use_en: Slow, heavy, gold. It holds the frame while the player reads the word.
use_zh: 缓慢、厚重、金色。玩家读字的时候由它撑住画面。
prompt_en: A single large firework against pure black. The trails hang in the air far longer than they take to form, so the shape stands as a drooping dome for most of the clip, then dims trail by trail until the frame is completely black again. One burst only, centred, unhurried, molten gold through amber with white only at the very heart of it. The background is pure flat black, completely empty and perfectly still: no smoke, no haze, no mist, no fog, no atmospheric glow, no ground, no horizon, no city, no buildings, no trees, no water, no reflections, no crowd, no silhouettes, no stars, no clouds, no moon. Nothing in the frame is lit except the firework itself. Locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax, no cuts, no scene change. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear. The burst stays fully inside the frame and never touches the edges.
